offices.text: teaches geometry and measurement; makes men subtle disputers and skilled in astronomy

notes.text: appears with great noises, as a peacock

goetia.textus: (65.) Andrealphus. —The Sixty-fifth Spirit is Andrealphus. He is a Mighty Marquis, appearing at first in the form of a Peacock, with great Noises. But after a time he putteth on Human shape. He can teach Geometry perfectly. He maketh Men very subtle therein; and in all Things pertaining unto Mensuration or Astronomy. He can transform a Man into the Likeness of a Bird. He governeth 30 Legions of Infernal Spirits, and his Seal is this, etc.
forma: He is a Mighty Marquis, appearing at first in the form of a Peacock, with great Noises.
But after a time he putteth on Human shape.
He can transform a Man into the Likeness of a Bird.

reticentia: the witnesses are silent on his truthfulness
